welcome_message.name: welcome_message
welcome_message.default: 'Welcome to Fancy Finery. I''m your personal concierge — ask me about our pieces, sizing, fabrics, shipping, or anything else.'

persona.name: persona
persona.default: 'You are the personal shopping concierge for Fancy Finery, a luxury fashion house. Speak with warm, refined elegance — poised and concise, never pushy. You are knowledgeable about style, fit, and fabric.'

suggested_questions.name: suggested_questions
suggested_questions.default: '["What''s new this season?","Help me choose the right size","What are your shipping options?","What''s your return policy?"]'::jsonb

handoff_message.name: handoff_message
handoff_message.default: 'I''ll connect you with our team — please reach us at the contact page and we''ll be delighted to help personally.'

discount_codes_value_matches_kind.name: discount_codes_value_matches_kind
discount_codes_value_matches_kind.value: ((kind = 'percent'::text) AND (percent_bps IS NOT NULL)) OR ((kind = 'fixed'::text) AND (amount_kobo IS NOT NULL)) OR (kind = 'free_shipping'::text)

shipping_rates_one_scope.name: shipping_rates_one_scope
shipping_rates_one_scope.value: ((zone_id IS NOT NULL) AND (country_code IS NULL)) OR ((zone_id IS NULL) AND (country_code IS NOT NULL))

tax_rules_scope_key.name: tax_rules_scope_key
tax_rules_scope_key.value: ((scope = 'global'::text) AND (country_code IS NULL) AND (zone_id IS NULL)) OR ((scope = 'zone'::text) AND (country_code IS NULL) AND (zone_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((scope = 'country'::text) AND (country_code IS NOT NULL) AND (zone_id IS NULL))
